pages.text: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. Roads and Highways Department, Sylhet Zone. Invitation for Tenders (IFT). Tender ID: 771204. Procurement Method: One Stage One Envelope. Tender Package No: RHD/SYL/2026-27/W-14.

1. The Roads and Highways Department invites sealed tenders from eligible Tenderers for the construction of a 2.4 km RCC road including drainage at Beanibazar, Sylhet. 2. The estimated cost of the Works is BDT 4,20,00,000 (four crore twenty lakh) only.
3. Tenders must be submitted through the e-GP portal at www.eprocure.gov.bd not later than 20 November 2026 at 14:00 hours Bangladesh Standard Time. 4. Late tenders shall be rejected.
5. The Tenderer shall have a minimum average annual turnover of BDT 1,50,00,000 (one crore fifty lakh) over the last three years.

6. The Tenderer shall have at least 5 years of general experience in construction works. 7. The Tenderer shall have completed at least one work of BDT 80,00,000 (eighty lakh) or more in a single contract during the last five years.

8. The tender security shall be BDT 2,00,000 (two lakh) in the form of a bank guarantee or pay order in favour of the Executive Engineer, RHD Sylhet. 9. The tender security shall remain valid for 120 days from the deadline for submission.

10. The following documents shall be submitted with the tender: (a) valid trade licence; (b) updated TIN certificate; (c) VAT registration certificate; (d) certificate of incorporation; (e) satisfactory completion certificates for similar works.
